ana: Hi folks — attaching an abbreviated manager/HR checklist for new ICs starting next week. Please confirm and add missing items. Day 1 focus = access + intro calls; Week 1 = context + small deliverable; 30/60/90 = goals + checkpoints.

devon: Thanks! I'll assign a buddy and schedule a Day 1 1:1.

ana: Checklist (copy for managers):
```
Day 0 (before start):
- Laptop + accounts provisioned (IT)
- Slack + SSO invite sent
- Access to repos + internal docs
- Calendar holds: 1:1, team sync, onboarding demos

Day 1:
- 9:00 welcome (People Ops)
- Setup walkthrough (IT/DevEx)
- Team intro + team goals + org map
- Assign mentor/buddy
- Small "first task" (read docs + run repo)

Week 1:
- Meet cross-functional partners (PM, SRE, Security)
- 30-min product overview + metrics intro
- First code review and PR workflow walkthrough
- Finish dev env + smoke tests

30/60/90 cadence:
- 30d: ramp up, ship first small piece, 2 PRs reviewed
- 60d: take ownership of a ticket stream, deliver measurable improvement
- 90d: lead a small rollout or cross-team demo, propose next goals
```

ana: Owners: People Ops (welcome/cal invites), IT (hardware/accounts), DevEx (dev env + repo access), Manager (goals + mentor). Add role-specific items below and owners.

devon: I'll own mentor pairing and the initial dev task. @it please confirm provisioning by EOD Thursday.

it-bot: IT ticket #3482 created for sam.lin — laptop + SSO provisioning requested. ETA: 2 business days.

sam.lin: Quick q — who grants access to the customer data sandbox? Need to run a couple of evals for my first task.

lena: @sam.lin I'll take the data access request. You'll need a signed NDA + manager approval. I'll send the template and start the ticket.

sam.lin: Thanks! Also, is there an internal prompt library / evals repo I should clone?

devon: Yes: git.internal/redwood/evals. @maya (DevEx) will share the README and add you to the repo.

maya: Sharing README + onboarding evals link: https://internal.redwood.dev/onboarding/evals — ping me if the repo permission fails.

sam.lin: One more — do we have a 30/60/90 template I can reuse?

ana: Yep — quick template (paste for managers):
- 30d: learn codebase, ship small bugfix, complete 2 PR reviews
- 60d: own a feature area, improve perf or test coverage by a measurable amount
- 90d: lead a cross-team demo, document impact and next steps
Ref: /hr/templates/30-60-90.md

devon: We'll review and set measurable goals in week-1 1:1.

sam.lin: Awesome, thanks everyone! :party_parrot:

ana: Closing loop — I'll update the master checklist with these additions and follow up with calendar invites and owners. :thumbsup:

maya: I'll set up evals repo access after IT finishes provisioning.
